copy.headline: Paxton drops suit against Dallas pediatrician over transgender care as he prepares to leave office
copy.caption: Brett Cooper was one of three doctors Paxton accused of violating Texas’ 2023 ban on gender-transition care for minors. The state dropped a similar case against an El Paso endocrinologist last year.
